subsystem.name: UIPlatformAndOptions
subsystem.responsibility: UI resource and texture plumbing plus the platform layer: a slot-array resource/texture manager (8 slots, shared linked list, per-element D3D texture creation), UI list node/texture-manager construction, recursive UI widget state propagation, conditional UI cleanup dispatch, device-backed parameter notification, D3D device-loss recovery and resource acquisition with reuse, UDP validate-message construction, and platform services (file open with mode selection, reserved DOS device-name rejection, thread shutdown, thread-safe stream reads, byte-buffer quicksort, per-thread TLS data).

summary: DERIVED architecture proposal for the ui_platform_and_options scope. The packet covers fifteen functions. (1) UI texture/resource layer: ResourceTextureManager (0x00546AA0) selects one of eight array slots by bitmask and acquires a named D3D-texture resource object, replacing an old object, reusing a shared linked-list object when found, or creating a new per-element texture set, with a -1 rollback on texture failure; UIListTextureManager (0x005510F0) is a constructor-style initializer for a UI list texture/scale manager and is reused by SceneUIListManager (0x0054BB40), which creates and links a UI list node into the scene chain; UIWidget (0x0054C1B0) recursively propagates widget state updates; UICleanupDispatcher (0x005528F0) conditionally dispatches cleanup through the UI cleanup iterator. (2) Device layer: DeviceStateParameter (0x00554610) notifies the global game device object (dword_8B89A0) through vtable slot +244, D3DResourceAcquirer (0x00554F80) acquires a texture-like resource with linked-list reuse and a device vtable slot +116 dispatch, and D3DDeviceManager (0x00555E50) performs Direct3D device-loss recovery (cooperative-level query, teardown, swap-chain recreation, restore) through the device vtable slots 0x3C/0xC/0x7C/0x38/0x40. (3) Session/platform layer: SessionValidateSender (0x005629B0) builds and sends a Base64-encoded UDP validate message, FileHandleObject (0x00566A70) opens files with a read/write mode selector, and PlatformServices groups four individually-evidenced free helpers: reserved DOS device-name rejection (0x005687F0), thread-safe stream read (0x0058803F), byte-buffer quicksort (0x005890AA) and per-thread TLS data (0x0058E0C7); ThreadHandleObject (0x00585550) performs thread shutdown with mutex-gated termination. Ownership of every object is UNKNOWN in the packet, so all class groupings are GUESS-level aggregations; equal offsets across owners are kept as separate base+offset fields.

function_roles.role: Resource/texture manager acquisition: decodes the a2 bitmask into one of eight 148-byte-stride slots at this+0xA8, tears down a replaced object (refcount drop, per-element destructor, linked-list removal), builds per-element names via StringFormatWithBufferOverflowCheck with the extension literal global 0x005CC79C, reuses a linked-list object when found and slot flag 0x100 is clear, otherwise allocates a new object and creates one D3D texture per element, appends to the shared list, refreshes list membership into this+0xB4, clears this+0x9C bit 1, and returns 0, or -1 after rollback on texture failure.

Creates a 40-byte UI list node from a source template, initializes it through the UI list texture manager (0x005510F0) using template data at a2+0xC, links it into the scene UI list-node chain (head at this+0x214, tail-next through the list-state container at this+0x238), fills per-item sequential indices, registers the node, collects rendering state via sub_557350, and conditionally attaches node state via sub_559200. Called by SceneNode (0x0055A910).

Recursively propagates a widget state update to two linked child widgets (this+0x44, this+0x4C) gated by a3 / (a3 & a4), then, when the flag-state object at this+0x230 is non-null, sets the global bit-1 flag (Bit1FlagSet) or clears the state flag (StateFlagBitClear) based on a2.

Constructor-style initializer for a UI list texture/scale manager: zero-initializes the struct, allocates and initializes a 76-byte sub-object (sub_556220) stored at this+0x0, registers it (sub_556260), allocates a count-header-prefixed array of 136-byte-stride scale-default elements, fills count at this+0x14 and array pointer at this+0x18, zeroes this+0x8/0xC/0x10/0x1C/0x20/0x24, and sets the constant flag 0x20000 at this+0x4.

Conditional cleanup dispatch: when flag bit 0x20000 at this+0x24 is set and the pointer at this+0x868 is non-null, dispatches UICleanupIterator (0x00554D70) on the object at this+0x868; otherwise returns the (possibly uninitialized) earlier result.

Sets a device-backed parameter: when the new value pointer a2 differs from the stored pointer at this+0x30, dispatches the stdcall virtual at vtable slot +244 of the global game device object dword_8B89A0 with the object identifier this+0x0 and a parameter value read from *(*(a2+84)+20) (or 0 when a2 is null), then stores a2 (or 0) at this+0x30. Used by state field setters and cleanup iterators.

Acquires a texture-like resource with reuse: reads the resource descriptor at a3+84 and, when its setup flag (index 6, bit 0x400) is clear, creates the resource via sub_554E90 into this+0x0; a -1 result triggers a linked-list search through ValueGetter(a2)+40 for a matching node to reuse, with a no-match fallback through StructFieldGetter and D3DResourceListCleanup before a retry; finally dispatches device vtable slot +116 via the device object at this+0x1100 when the descriptor has a target, marks the setup bit 0x400, clears descriptor index 14 and returns 1.

Direct3D device-loss recovery: queries device state via the interface at this+0x1100 (vtable slot 0x3C, returning -2005530520 device-lost, then slot 0xC returning -2005530519 device-not-reset), resets the device (slot 0x7C), tears down (sub_53F6E0, RenderTargetCleanup), sets the display mode (slot 0x38, error reported via sub_53C590 with the aCouldNotSetDis message and format global 0x005DBCE4), recreates an additional swap chain (slot 0x40), maps the display-mode selector at this+0x1114 through the jump table, recreates via sub_53F3F0, re-resets, restores via sub_53EB70, and sets flag bit 2 on the caller result a3 when the reset completed.

Builds a network message over a UDP socket: when the validation string a4 is non-empty and at most 128 chars, combines it with object data at a1+72 (sub_562150), Base64-encodes it, formats a '\validate\%s' segment (format global 0x005E4EB4) and appends it (sub_562710); always appends the mandatory final segment from global aFinal (0x005E4EAC) and sends the composed buffer with sub_562610. Returns 0 without sending when a4 exceeds 128 chars.

File open helper: optionally runs the a5-gated FileAttributeCheckSequence on the name a2, stores the mode arguments at this+0x0C and this+0x10, clears the local path buffer (sub_568620), opens through sub_587DB0 choosing the read-mode path global unk_5E517C or the write-mode path global unk_5E5180 based on this+0x0C, stores the handle at this+0x00, zeroes this+0x18, and copies the resolved path into this+0x04 when the handle is valid.

Reserved DOS device-name check: builds a 23-entry candidate table (CON, PRN, AUX, CLOCK$, COM1-COM9, LPT1-LPT9), copies up to 7 chars of the input name, truncates at the first separator or dot, compares against each candidate via sub_588410, and returns 1 on match else 0.

Thread shutdown and cleanup: retries ThreadResumeWithMutexWait up to 10 times with a 250 ms sleep, then, when the thread handle at this+0x4 is live, sets the termination flag at this+0xC under the mutex at this+0x10 (wait timeout this+0x14), waits indefinitely on the thread handle, closes it, and clears the handle/id fields at this+0x4/0x8.

Synchronous thread-safe read wrapper: acquires the stream lock via StreamBufferLockViaCriticalSection(a4), performs the read by forwarding (a1,a2,a3,a4) to sub_58806E, releases via AddressRangeCriticalSectionLeave(a4), and returns the inner read result. Shared across deserialization, file enumeration, scene parsing, mesh loading and file-write paths.

Iterative quicksort over an array of a2 elements each a3 bytes at base a1, ordered by the caller-supplied comparator a4: small subarrays (8 or fewer) are handed to sub_5891FE, the middle element becomes the pivot (ByteBufferSwap), a Hoare-style scan partitions the range, and the larger partition is processed in place while the smaller is pushed onto an explicit stack.

CRT-style per-thread data retrieval: saves GetLastError, reads the per-thread data block via TlsGetValue(dwTlsIndex); on first access lazily allocates a 116-byte block (sub_58AB58), registers it with TlsSetValue, initializes it (TwoFieldInitializer_e0b4), stamps it with the current thread id and a -1 sentinel, terminates with CRTAmsgExit(0x10) on failure, and restores the saved LastError before returning.

classes.name: ResourceTextureManager
classes.responsibility: Acquires named D3D-texture resource objects into one of eight slot-array entries at this+0xA8 (148-byte stride): replaces or tears down old objects, reuses shared linked-list objects, creates per-element textures, maintains linked-list membership (this+0xB0/this+0xB4) and flag state (this+0x9C).

classes.name: SceneUIListManager
classes.responsibility: Creates UI list nodes from templates, initializes them through the UI list texture manager, links them into the scene UI list-node chain (head at this+0x214, tail-next through the list-state container at this+0x238), fills per-item indices, and attaches rendering state.

classes.name: UIWidget
classes.responsibility: Recursively propagates a widget state update to two linked child widgets and sets/clears a shared state flag through the flag-state object at this+0x230.

classes.name: UIListTextureManager
classes.responsibility: Constructor-style initializer for a UI list texture/scale manager: allocates a 76-byte sub-object, registers it, allocates a count-header-prefixed 136-byte-stride element array, and fills count/array/flag fields.

classes.name: UICleanupDispatcher
classes.responsibility: Conditional cleanup dispatch: when flag bit 0x20000 at this+0x24 is set and this+0x868 holds a non-null object, dispatches UICleanupIterator on it.

classes.name: DeviceStateParameter
classes.responsibility: Sets a device-backed parameter by dispatching a stdcall virtual (vtable slot +244) on the global game device object dword_8B89A0 and recording the applied pointer at this+0x30.

classes.name: D3DResourceAcquirer
classes.responsibility: Acquires a texture-like resource, reusing an existing linked-list node when possible, with a fallback cleanup/retry path and a final device vtable slot +116 dispatch through the device object at this+0x1100.

classes.name: D3DDeviceManager
classes.responsibility: Direct3D device-loss recovery and recreation: queries cooperative-level state through the device interface at this+0x1100, resets and re-creates the render targets and an additional swap chain, maps the display-mode selector, restores device state, and reports completion on the caller result.

classes.name: SessionValidateSender
classes.responsibility: Builds a UDP validate message: combines existing object data with the validation string, Base64-encodes it into a '\validate\%s' segment, appends a mandatory final segment, and sends the composed buffer.

classes.name: FileHandleObject
classes.responsibility: File open helper object: stores mode arguments, opens the file through the mode-selected path, and keeps the handle, resolved path string and a zeroed flag byte.

classes.name: ThreadHandleObject
classes.responsibility: Thread shutdown object: retries resume, sets the termination flag under a mutex, waits on and closes the thread handle, and clears the handle/id fields.

classes.name: PlatformServices
classes.responsibility: Platform/utility helpers, each independently evidenced: reserved DOS device-name rejection (0x005687F0), thread-safe stream read wrapper (0x0058803F), generic byte-buffer quicksort (0x005890AA) and CRT per-thread TLS data access (0x0058E0C7).

state_machines.name: ResourceSlotAcquisition
states: replace_old_object (existing object refcount drop and teardown)
reuse_existing (linked-list match found and slot flag 0x100 clear)
create_new (per-element name build and D3D texture creation)
completed (linked-list append, list refresh, this+0x9C bit 1 cleared)

existing object refcount drops from 1 to 0, destructor and linked-list removal run, slot+140 detached
D3DTextureCreation returns nonzero; created elements torn down, allocation freed, slot+140 detached, return -1
all elements' textures created; object appended to linked list and refcount bumped
matched object refcount bumped, jump to completion

vtable slot 0xC state re-query returns -2005530519; otherwise return 0
Reset (slot 0x7C) plus teardown (sub_53F6E0, RenderTargetCleanup), display-mode set (slot 0x38), additional swap-chain creation (slot 0x40), recreation pass sub_53F3F0 and second Reset

display-mode set result nonzero; message formatted from globals 0x005DBCE4/0x005DBCF0 reported via sub_53C590, return -1

Shared by deserialization, file enumeration, scene parsing, mesh loading and file-write paths.

compatibility_contracts.name: ResourceTextureSlotContract
compatibility_contracts.description: The texture manager keeps 8 array slots at this+0xA8 (148-byte stride), each holding a resource object pointer at slot+140 and an element count at slot+72. Acquisition returns 0 on success (reuse or fresh create) and -1 on texture-creation failure after tearing down created elements, freeing the allocation and detaching slot+140. Reuse requires a shared linked-list match (StringSearchInLinkedList) plus slot flag 0x100 clear; the object refcount governs teardown.

compatibility_contracts.name: D3DDeviceLossRecoveryContract
compatibility_contracts.description: Device-loss recovery must follow the observed sequence: vtable slot 0x3C cooperative-level query returning -2005530520 (device lost) and slot 0xC returning -2005530519 (device not reset) gate the recovery; then slot 0x7C Reset, teardown (sub_53F6E0 / RenderTargetCleanup 0x0053F270), slot 0x38 display-mode set, slot 0x40 additional swap-chain creation, recreation pass sub_53F3F0, second Reset and restore pass sub_53EB70, with the display-mode selector mapping at this+0x1114 (2->32, 3->256, 4->64, 0x10->0x100000) and return -1 on error or -2 on success with bit 2 set on the caller result.

compatibility_contracts.name: GameDeviceParameterNotificationContract

compatibility_contracts.name: ReservedDosDeviceNameContract
compatibility_contracts.description: A device-name string must be rejected when its first up-to-7 characters, truncated at the first separator or dot (backslash, slash, colon, dot), equal one of the 23 reserved DOS device names (CON, PRN, AUX, CLOCK$, COM1-COM9, LPT1-LPT9); returns 1 on match, else 0.

compatibility_contracts.description: A thread-safe synchronous read must acquire the stream lock (0x0058C1B1), forward (a1,a2,a3,a4) to the inner read (0x0058806E), release the lock (0x0058C203) and return the inner result unchanged.
